name: Cognitive Artifact Protocol
objective: Define the canonical lifecycle, truth rank, freshness, ownership, token role, promotion rules and invalidation rules for DUMMIE cognitive artifacts.
why_now: P3 identified which artifact types exist and what lifecycle/freshness/canonicality gaps must be governed before creating notes, noteplans, ContextQuant or autonomy systems.
must_not_create: runtime-heavy ContextQuant implementation before artifact protocol exists
success_conditions: artifact protocol validates against P3 matrix
